bookmarks.description: List of bookmarks (directories with optional descriptions). Each item must have 'path' and optionally 'description'. Path must be absolute; description is a free-text label for quick identification. Lines starting with '#' are ignored as comments in the actual file, but comments are not modeled here to keep it simple and production-sane — only bookmarks are templated. Invalid paths (e.g., non-existent) are marked with '!' in cdargs UI and handled gracefully by cdargs itself. No validation is performed here — cdargs does runtime validation and display handling per manual. See FILES section for file location ($HOME/.cdargs).
